messages.message: AI will augment, not replace programmers.
I think anthropic and tesla will win this race btw

Hi, I am Imperial. I personally believe I am strong in the programming topic. I think it may in future be able to take over but I also believe it will not, Lets stop here so I can explain the pros and cons of this:
--PROS--
1. Faster Coding
This will be increased speed from weeks/months down to hours if not, minutes!
2. Fast Proof Reading And Error Fixes
This makes the time also cut down lining up with the first pro!
3. Cheaper Costs
AI to run locally from your device is free as you already own the device and hiring Coders cost upwards of 10$ an hour up to hundreds!

--CONS--

1. Coders will be left without a job
I believe this here explains it smoothly without going into detail!
2. This will also make prices for hardware such as ram, motherboards, hard-drives, solid-state-drives all cost a lot more!
I believe this here explains it smoothly without going into detail!
3. Running AI needs power
This takes up recourses. and running a big AI data centre uses fossil fuels and oil to keep power. Solar power is a lot more of a safer option, Which knocks this con out of the park
